A bill for an act relating to agriculture; creating the State Agricultural Society public safety account in the agricultural fund; instituting a 30 cent surcharge on State Agricultural Society admission tickets; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 37.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[37.135] STATE AGRICULTURAL SOCIETY PUBLIC SAFETY ACCOUNT; APPROPRIATION; FEES. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Establishment; appropriation.+]

[+A State Agricultural Society public safety account is established in the agricultural fund. Money in the account, including interest, is appropriated to the board of managers of the State Agricultural Society for grants to the cities of Falcon Heights and St. Paul to provide: +]

[+(1) public safety services, such as police, fire, and emergency medical responses; +]

[+(2) public works expenses for traffic management and sanitation; and +]

[+(3) neighborhood cleanup and restoration efforts. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Fees.+]

[+The board of managers of the State Agricultural Society shall charge a supplementary 30 cent fee on each admission ticket. All fees collected under this section shall be deposited in the state treasury and credited to the State Agricultural Society account in the agricultural fund under this section. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; creating the State Agricultural Society public safety account in the agricultural fund; instituting a 30 cent surcharge on State Agricultural Society admission tickets; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 37.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[37.135] STATE AGRICULTURAL SOCIETY PUBLIC SAFETY ACCOUNT; APPROPRIATION; FEES.

Subdivision 1.

Establishment; appropriation.

A State Agricultural Society public safety account is established in the agricultural fund. Money in the account, including interest, is appropriated to the board of managers of the State Agricultural Society for grants to the cities of Falcon Heights and St. Paul to provide:

(1) public safety services, such as police, fire, and emergency medical responses;

(2) public works expenses for traffic management and sanitation; and

(3) neighborhood cleanup and restoration efforts.

Subd. 2.

Fees.

The board of managers of the State Agricultural Society shall charge a supplementary 30 cent fee on each admission ticket. All fees collected under this section shall be deposited in the state treasury and credited to the State Agricultural Society account in the agricultural fund under this section.
additions: [37.135] STATE AGRICULTURAL SOCIETY PUBLIC SAFETY ACCOUNT; APPROPRIATION; FEES.
